name: bakeout-functions
description: BakeOut server side: Cherry's brain, matching, recipes, account deletion.

scripts.check:cherry: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions "node scripts/seed-dev-match.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/cherry.emulator.test.mjs"
scripts.check:chat: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore "node scripts/seed-dev-match.mjs && (node scripts/dev-replier.mjs &) && cd ../app && flutter test integration_test/chat_test.dart --dart-define=USE_EMULATORS=true -d ${SIM:-iPhone}"
